name: Santiago
summary: Santiago combines the strongest infrastructure in South America for digital nomads—fast fiber, modern coworkings, and a startup ecosystem powered by Start-Up Chile—with the Andes mountain range as a backdrop on clear days. The cost of living remains low by European standards, although winter smog, traffic and seismic activity are the real downside to living here.
